env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

env CC=
env CGO_ENABLED=

[!race] skip 'the platform has no race detector'
[!cgo] skip 'a Go main module needs the default C compiler on PATH'

cd forbid

# A Go main module (no .lgo file) keeps the upstream default for
# CGO_ENABLED under logos, and the cgo key has no effect: the race
# runtime still links in deps, and no policy refusal appears.
! stderr 'requires cgo'
logos list -race -test -deps -f '{{.ImportPath}}' ./pure
! stderr 'requires cgo'
stdout '^runtime/race$'
# The race runtime links runtime/cgo everywhere but darwin.
[!GOOS:darwin] stdout '^runtime/cgo$'
# net carries cgo files everywhere but Windows.
[!GOOS:windows] logos list -race -test -deps -f '{{if eq .ImportPath "net"}}cgo={{.CgoFiles}}{{end}}' ./pure
[!GOOS:windows] ! stderr 'requires cgo'
[!GOOS:windows] stdout 'cgo=\[.+'

-- forbid/go.mod --
module example.com/forbidgomodule

go 1.27

-- forbid/logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "forbid"

-- forbid/pure/pure.go --
package pure

func Add(a int, b int) int { return a + b }

-- forbid/pure/pure_test.go --
package pure

import (
	"net"
	"testing"
)

func TestAdd(t *testing.T) {
	if Add(1, 2) != 3 {
		t.Fatal("wrong sum")
	}
	if !net.ParseIP("127.0.0.1").IsLoopback() {
		t.Fatal("127.0.0.1 is not a loopback address")
	}
}
